name: Negroni
instructions: Add gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir for 30 seconds until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Express an orange peel over the drink and drop it in.

name: Espresso Martini
instructions: Brew a fresh shot of espresso and let it cool slightly.
Add vodka, espresso, coffee liqueur, and simple syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds to build a frothy top.
Double strain into a chilled coupe glass.
Garnish with three coffee beans on top of the foam.

name: Paloma
instructions: Rim a highball glass with salt and fill with ice.
Pour in the tequila and fresh lime juice.
Top with grapefruit soda and stir gently.
Garnish with a grapefruit wedge and serve.

name: Citrus Sunrise
instructions: Juice the oranges, grapefruit, and lemon into a large measuring jug.
Finely grate the ginger and stir it into the juice.
Add honey or agave and stir until dissolved.
Fill a tall glass with ice and pour the juice over.
Garnish with an orange wheel and serve immediately.

name: Green Detox
instructions: Wash all produce thoroughly under cold water.
Chop the apples, cucumber, and celery into pieces that fit your juicer.
Juice the spinach and celery first, then the apple and cucumber.
Add the lemon juice and ginger at the end for brightness.
Stir gently, pour over ice, and serve fresh.

name: Watermelon & Mint
instructions: Blend the watermelon cubes until smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh sieve to remove pulp.
Muddle the mint leaves gently in the bottom of a glass.
Pour the watermelon juice over the mint and add lime juice.
Add ice and top with a splash of sparkling water if desired.
Stir gently and garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Virgin Mojito
instructions: Place the mint leaves, lime wedges, and sugar in a tall glass.
Muddle gently to release the mint oils and lime juice.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Top with soda water and stir well to combine.
Garnish with a fresh mint sprig and a lime wheel.

name: Berry Spritz
instructions: Muddle the raspberries and blackberries in a shaker.
Add lemon juice, simple syrup, and a handful of ice.
Shake well and double strain into a wine glass over ice.
Top with sparkling water and stir gently.
Garnish with a rosemary sprig and a few whole berries.

name: Ginger Mule
instructions: Combine the grated ginger, lime juice, and honey in a copper mug or glass.
Stir until the honey dissolves.
Fill with ice and pour the ginger beer over.
Add a dash of bitters if desired and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wheel and serve.
